༄༅/ /mchod rten brgyad kyi thig rtsa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// mchod rten brgyad kyi thig rtsa bzhugs so//

'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag byas nas// gtsug tor dri med 'grel pa nas// mkhas pa'i dbang po bus phyung ba// bde gshegs mchod rten ma nor thig 1 /'tsham pa'i tshangs zur log thig gdab// tshangs pa'i g.yas g.yonabasdoms pas cha chen brgyad// rtsa rtse'i bar la bcu drug ste// kun kyang cha chung bzhi bzhir bgos/ 2 /'di ni mchod rten kun gyi gzhi// ma ga dhar ni bdud btul dang*// sangs rgya'i dus byung bdud 'dul lam// ming gzhan byang chub mchod rten zer/ 3 /'di la sa 'dzin dpangs su cha chung gnyis// rgyar ni tshangs nas bcu drug cha chung gcig /bzhir gsil ba yi bzhi cha gsum gnyis bzhi gnyis gnyis/bzhi gnyis /them skas gsum rgyar gcig phyed phyed/ 4 /phri ba khri bdun 'og bzhi cha/thig gdan// steng du de 'dra gnyis rnams rim// thig gdan pad chung gzung sar shes// khri brgya bcu gsum lhag ma gsum/ 5 /bzhi cha phyir 'phar pad chen la// phyed gnyis bcu bzhi rmang gcig phyed// phri bya 'di man mdzes phyir byas/ 6 /bang rim rer gnyis bcu gsum dang*// bcu gnyis bcu gcig bcu rgya'i tshad// rang rang sum cha bar du bya// de 'og phyed khri bum gdan gcig 7 /rgyar ni phyed dgu bum dpangs la// bcu gnyis steng 'og rgyar brgyad brgyad// 'og dang tshangs nas bcu yi mthar// steng nas der gzhol zlum mdzes bya/ 8 /bum steng gcig phyed 'og ma gsil// gsum dang chas dman bre gdan yin// bre rke gcig rgya phyed gsum steng*// phyed gsil bzhi cha re 'phar ba/ 9 /de steng phyed bcas gcig bre rgyar// phyed bzhi 'degs pad phyed dang gnyis// rtsar gsum kha la phyed dang bzhi// rtse mo'i gcig tog gnyis nyi ma/ 10 /gcig zla gcig gdugs lhag ma nas// 'degs pad tshun par rtsa phyed bzhi// rtse mo gcig mnyam bcu bzhir bgos// dang po mdo gzungs lhag gdugs te/ 11 /pho 'khor gsum gnyis mo de lhag

/'bur dang kyong mar shes par bya// gdugs khebs 'khor lo bdun pa dang*// gdugs rang drug pa za ra tshags/ 12 /mdzes pa zla rtse nyi ma'i phyed// sngar gzhung kun nas cha chen gcig /steng nas rgya las phyed dor snang*// des na de btab dgos med pas/ 13 /ma dor dbus su nyer bzhi 'di ka bu ston rjes// yum don bzhengs la 'di bzhin snang*// de phyir 'di la yid brtan 'os// 'khor mo 'jig gam gsal ldan du/ 14 /chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus byung ba// sgo mang 'di ni sa 'dzin nas// bang rim rtse tshun bre kun la// logs dbus pad 'og bang rim dang po'i gzhi gnyis ni/ 15 /sum cha gcig gis 'bur ba yin// bzhi dor sgo chung char rten 'og /bang rim rnams la bya ba yin// bum pa bre la'ang yod pa rnams/ 16 /mnyan yod ston pa drug btul tshe// byung bas cho 'phrul chen po ste// sgo dpangs gzhan ni snga ma bzhin// yum don 'chi med grong bzhugs nas/ 16 /mo'u 'gal gyis gsol mi yul du// slar babs gsal ldan grong byon tshe// dar bas lha las babs pa'o// cho 'phrul 'dra la khyad par ni/ 18 /bang rim glo 'bur sum char bgos// dbus gsum skas 'gram gdang gnyis te// lum+bi nī tshal ston pa bltams// zhabs dor sa la pad+mo 'khrungs/ 19 /de spungs las byung pad spungs so// 'di khyad byang chen bang rim rnams// zlum por byas pa pad+mos brgyan// 'od ma'i tshal du lhas sbyin gyis/ 20 /dge 'dun dbyen byas de dgongs rang*// mchog zung gis bsdums der byung bas// dge 'dun dbyen bzlums mchod rten lo// g.yas kyi bum gdan rtse mo nas/ 21 /gyen gsegs cha chung phyed pa bsnan// rmang gyen gcig dang sum cha dor// shar nub bzhir bgos bzhi cha bslangs// mgo byed thig tshad mtha' yang yin/ 22 /'bur la rmang steng cha brgyad las// zur rnams zlum por bcad pa yin// yangs pa can du bdud kyis su// mya ngan 'das gsol zhal bzhes nas/

23 /sku tshe'i 'du byed btang bar mdzad// slar yang mgar ba'i bu tsun+das// zhus ngor 'tsho ba'i 'du byed ni// byin brlabs de tshe dar bas na/ 24 /sku tshe'i 'du byed byin brlabs pa'i// mchod rten rnam rgyal nas gsungs dang*// phal cher 'dra bas rnam rgyal lo// dge bcu'i steng du cha chung gcig 25 /lhag ma bdun la bang rim gsum// pad+ma bang rim zlum po yin// gyad yul rtswa mchog grong khyer du// mya ngan 'das bstan der dar bas/ 26 /mya 'das mchod rten zhes grags pa// bang rim med pas 'di la ni// sa 'dzin gsum dang them skas la// phyed gnyis re re phyed kyi gdan/ 27 /seng khri bcu la phyed pa gnyis// pad chen gnyis la dge bcu gnyis// bum gdan yan ni sngar bzhin no// pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba dge legs su gyur cig// /shu bhaṃ// maṅga laṃ/// /
